$comment: Single source of the KenteXa office (Ofisi) screen rules. Copied from bishoo-frontend/src/public/pages/SuperAgentDashboard.js and components/HubExpectedShipments.js as they are today. The server (src/super-agents/super-agents.service.ts) remains the authority for who may set each status. Changing a group here changes what the web and the Ofisi app show, so change it only with owner approval. Checked by scripts/office-rules/check-web.js; the native copy is generated by scripts/office-rules/sync-mobile.js.

regionMatch.$comment: Same place or not. Copied from bishoo-frontend/src/utils/regionMatch.js (backend: src/super-agents/region-match.ts).

walkIn.$comment: Walk-in counter rules copied from SuperAgentDashboard.js (handleWalkSubmit) and OfficePricePreview.js.

statusModal.$comment: Status change rules copied from SuperAgentDashboard.js (status modal, handleConfirmPickup, handleSendPickupCode, handleIssueAgentHandoff). preDispatchStatuses decides which intake options show. Server enforces the same stages.

localDispatch.$comment: Parcel for the same town goes to a local agent (web: isDirectLocalParcel + 'Chagua Agent').

handover.$comment: Agent handovers awaiting receipt at this hub (web: 'Agent handovers awaiting receipt').

pricing.$comment: Office prices copied from bishoo-frontend/src/public/components/OfficePrices.js, ChargeRuleSection.js, RouteRangePanel.js and OfficePickupCard.js.

partners.$comment: Washirika and referral rules copied from bishoo-frontend/src/public/components/InviteCarrier.js, OfficePartners.js and SuperAgentDashboard.js (referral card).

officePoint.source: The phone's GPS, captured once at the office. The server checks it: inside Tanzania and accuracy within its limit (server rule, 500 m).

texts.setGps: Mahali pa ofisi pamewekwa kwa GPS.
texts.title: Weka mahali pa ofisi
texts.explain: Kwa nini: mahali pa GPS ndiyo yanamwonyesha mteja ofisi yako ilipo hasa. Ofisi ikiwa na mahali pa GPS, wateja walio karibu nayo wanaiona, na "Fungua ramani" inaelekeza mahali pa kweli. Bila hiyo, ofisi inalinganishwa kwa jina la mji tu, na mahali pake ni katikati ya eneo. Simama ndani au mlangoni mwa ofisi, kisha bonyeza.
texts.onlyPlace: Ofisi ina mahali pa makadirio tu (katikati ya eneo). Weka kwa GPS ukiwa ofisini ili wateja wakupate kwa usahihi.
